page.description:
The page geometry the card renders into. A card is ONE page format, not a document direction, so there are exactly two values and no third: a report that is portrait A4 is `a4`, one that is a 16:9 deck is `slide`. `auto` lets the renderer pick from measured content height.

Omitted = `auto`, so a card written before this key existed is unchanged.

state.description: Per-canvas initial state for reactive blocks (controls write here).

cardinality.description: Crow's-foot terminator at the far end.

DiagramNode.description: A node with `fields` renders as an ENTITY box: header bar + one row per field. `shape` only changes the box treatment; the dagre layout already takes an explicit {width,height}, so a taller box with internal text needs no layout engine work and no new dependency.

fields.description: Column list; only meaningful when shape is "entity" (the ER default for layout:"relationship"). pk → key glyph, fk → arrow, nullable → dimmed.

symbol.description: A standard circuit glyph drawn inside the node box.

id.description: Opaque short id; the only identity the renderer needs.

merge.description: Rounds the row and merges lanes (a merge commit).

parents.description: Parent commit ids. A parent on ANOTHER branch is what draws the fork.

kind.description: Free-form grouping; drives the cross-filter chips and the opacity tier.

TableStat.description: The summary statistics `table.stats` may request. All computed in the renderer from the rendered rows, so a wrong number cannot be authored.

columns.description: Which columns to summarise. Omitted = every numeric column.

compute.description: Omitted = every statistic, for the chosen columns.
